display.title: Level Up
display.subtitle: Raise any aptitude to level 2
description: Aptitudes are your character's eight stats. Each one starts at level 1.
Open the Aptitudes screen (default key: Y) and spend experience levels to raise any one of them to level 2.

jlf_level_5.description: Have any aptitude at level 2 or higher. Checked every few seconds.
